page_title: VAL 1-0 MAL | Valencia v Mallorca 30/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+10' The foul by Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Francisco Maeso.
90+9' Abdon Prats (Mallorca) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
90+8' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) will deliver the corner kick.
90+7' Today's referee Francisco Maeso rightly decides to book Jose Gaya (Valencia) for his harsh tackle.
90+6' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) receives a precise pass and threatens the keeper with a long-range shot. His attempt goes miles wide of the left post.
90+5' Here comes a substitution. Jesus Vazquez (Valencia) is brought on as a substitute for Luis Rioja.
90+4' Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) has received a yellow card for his foul.
90+4' Carlos Corberan (Valencia) gets a yellow card, off the field.
90+3' Marc Domenech (Mallorca) commits a foul and Francisco Maeso immediately signals a free kick.

90+1' Abdon Prats (Mallorca) wins some space for himself around the penalty spot and manages to produce a promising header. One of the defenders stops his effort before it gets to the goalkeeper, making him redundant.
90' 8 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' The resulting set piece from Mallorca is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
85' Francisco Maeso shows the yellow card to Enzo Barrenechea (Valencia) for a heavy challenge.
84' Luis Rioja (Valencia) sees a yellow! His tackle wasn't that harsh, but he probably talked himself into Francisco Maeso's book.
84' Pepelu (Valencia) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
82' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
80' Here's the change. David Lopez leaves the pitch and Valery (Mallorca) comes on as a substitute.
80' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to make a change. Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) replaces Samu Costa.
80' The manager makes a subsitution with Johan Mojica (Mallorca) coming on for Toni Lato.
79' The resulting corner from Pepelu (Valencia) is cleared.
78' Pepelu (Valencia) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
76' Francisco Maeso shows a yellow card to Samu Costa (Mallorca), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
76' The attendance is 44082.
75' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Mouctar Diakhaby (Valencia) comes onto the pitch so that Andre Almeida can be given a rest.
75' Here comes a substitution. Umar Sadiq is given a rest as he is replaced by Rafa Mir (Valencia).
74' Luis Rioja (Valencia) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
73' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to substitute Takuma Asano and he is replaced by Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca).
73' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Sergi Darder trots off the pitch and is replaced by Marc Domenech (Mallorca).
70' The free kick is taken by Sergi Darder (Mallorca), but ball is cleared.
68' Andre Almeida (Valencia) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Francisco Maeso signals. It's a free kick to Mallorca in a dangerous position.
66' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Fran Perez is coming onto the pitch as Diego Lopez (Valencia) cannot continue after picking up an injury.
66' Carlos Corberan prepares a substitution. Javi Guerra is replaced by Pepelu (Valencia).
65' Takuma Asano (Mallorca) plants his close-range header just wide of the left post after a cross into the box.
65' Mallorca can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
63' Takuma Asano (Mallorca) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Mallorca have a corner.
63' Enzo Barrenechea (Valencia) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
62' Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) makes a strong challenge and Francisco Maeso blows for a foul.
61' Valencia quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
60' Manu Morlanes (Mallorca) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
59' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.

59' Manu Morlanes (Mallorca) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Mallorca will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
57' Toni Lato (Mallorca) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
56' Francisco Maeso blows for a foul after Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
54' Diego Lopez (Valencia) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well over the bar.
52' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) commits a foul during an attacking move.
50' 1 - 0 Diego Lopez (Valencia) breaks through before collecting a brilliant pass and producing a precise strike to beat the goalkeeper. The ball went into the bottom right corner.
49' The linesman raises his flag. Umar Sadiq (Valencia) is adjudged offside.
48' Javi Guerra (Valencia) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Francisco Maeso no option but to blow his whistle.
47' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) finds his way to a rebound on the edge of the box, shoots to the left side of the goal, but the keeper dives and denies him.
46' Takuma Asano (Mallorca) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' Francisco Maeso blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+3' Umar Sadiq (Valencia) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
45+1' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) picks up a yellow card.

45+1' Takuma Asano (Mallorca) receives a short pass inside a congested penalty area and takes a first-time shot. The effort heads towards the middle of the goal but Giorgi Mamardashvili blocks the shot with his legs.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' The ball is cleared after Toni Lato (Mallorca) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
44' Cesar Tarrega (Valencia) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
43' Although Jagoba Arrasate (Mallorca) is just on the bench, Francisco Maeso has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
43' Samu Costa (Mallorca) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement.
41' Samu Costa (Mallorca) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while in possession of the ball.
40' Francisco Maeso blows his whistle. Diego Lopez (Valencia) commits a foul after dangerous play.
38' Valencia are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
36' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) is able to continue to play.
35' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
34' Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) brings an opponent down and Francisco Maeso interrupts the game.
33' Takuma Asano (Mallorca) picks up a long through ball, but Giorgi Mamardashvili deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
32' Takuma Asano (Mallorca) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
30' Wasted effort! Manu Morlanes (Mallorca) drives to the edge of the box after picking up a rebound, but his shot is tame and bends well wide of the left post.
30' Mallorca have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
28' Cesar Tarrega (Valencia) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Francisco Maeso blows his whistle for a foul.
24' Andre Almeida (Valencia) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.

24' Javi Guerra (Valencia) tries his luck and takes a shot from inside the box. His effort on goal is blocked by a defender. Valencia have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
21' Takuma Asano (Mallorca) wins the ball near the penalty spot and unleashes a header towards the middle of the goal, but Giorgi Mamardashvili is alert and denies him.
18' Umar Sadiq (Valencia) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
16' Cesar Tarrega (Valencia) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Francisco Maeso has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
12' Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) sees a yellow card from Francisco Maeso after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
11' Samu Costa (Mallorca) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
8' Andre Almeida (Valencia) connects with a pass inside the box, but his effort goes well wide of the left post.
8' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.
5' Takuma Asano (Mallorca) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
3' The Valencia players are exchanging some short passes.
